lines.en: I cross the conifer forest with my head low.

lines.zh: 我的长牙在雪地里很显眼。
lines.en: My long fangs show against the snow.
I walk beside my companions.
My four feet plant firmly.
I walk over the pine needles.
I pause by an old tree.
I catch up with the group.
I sniff at what lies under the snow.
My back is a little arched.
I climb the slope.

lines.zh: 我的爪子在冰壳上滑了一下。
lines.en: My claws slip on the ice crust.
I steady myself at once.
I step around a fallen log.
I head deeper into the trees.
I stand under a pine.

lines.zh: 雪落在我的背上，针叶林很静。
lines.en: Snow falls on my back; the taiga is quiet.

lines.zh: 我舔了舔前爪，抹了把脸。
lines.en: I lick a forepaw and wipe my face.
I listen to what moves beneath the snow.
My tail lies along my flank.
I breathe out white air.
Tilted my head. Didn't understand.

lines.zh: 我的毛色和枯草分不清。
lines.en: My coat blends into the dead grass.
Frost clings to my fangs.
I tuck a forefoot in a little.
The woods are quiet.
I prick my ears again.

lines.zh: 我趴在雪上，体温融出一个坑。
lines.en: I lie on the snow, my warmth melting a pit.
I crouch low, long canines forward.

lines.zh: 雪后的空气里，你太显眼。
lines.en: In the after-snow air, you stand out.

lines.zh: 我龇出那对长剑一样的牙。
lines.en: I bare those sword-long canines.

lines.zh: 针叶林里，我的气味到处都是。
lines.en: In the pine forest, my scent is everywhere.
My companions see you too.

lines.zh: 往前挪一小步，再一小步。
lines.en: One small step, then another.
My canines are long as knives.

lines.zh: 我的胡须上结了一层霜。
lines.en: Frost has formed on my whiskers.

lines.zh: 雪把我们的声音都吸走了。
lines.en: The snow swallows both our sounds.
I arch my back, mane bristling.
I shake my head, ears flat.
My blood is on the snow.
My companions cry out too.
I grit my teeth.

lines.zh: 雪地上多了几滴我的血。
lines.en: A few drops of my blood stain the snow.
I did not run.

lines.zh: 我舔掉嘴角的血，继续盯。
lines.en: I lick blood from my lip and keep staring.
I will fight back.

lines.zh: 我闻了闻你的干粮，走开。
lines.en: I sniff your rations and walk away.
I sniff and step back.
This is not alive.
Don't reach in — my teeth are crowded.
My companions will come first.
I bite a mouthful of snow and spit it out.

lines.zh: 那块肉的味道，隔着林子都闻到了。
lines.en: I can smell that meat clear across the woods.

lines.zh: 你手里拿的，是给我的吗？
lines.en: What's in your hand? Is that for me?
My frame is heavy.
My shoulder pushes against your shield.
My shoulder shoves you aside.
The snow crunches under us.
I plant all four feet.

lines.zh: 你撞得我爪子陷进雪里。
lines.en: The hit drives my paws into the snow.
My fangs are close.
I pull back again.
I step aside, then fall in behind.
The three of us travel together.
She always walks ahead of me.
Our prints overlap.
She sniffs me.

lines.zh: 我们的长牙在雪光里发白。
lines.en: Our long canines gleam white in the snowlight.
The woods are cold, so we stay close.
Snow falls from the pine boughs.
We take the same path.
The dark comes quickly.
We find a place out of the wind.
This has gone cold.
I drag the bone under the roots.

lines.zh: 我用鼻子拱了拱，没兴趣。
lines.en: I nudge it with my nose, uninterested.
Not meat; no use.

lines.zh: 我用前爪把雪刨到一边。
lines.en: I scrape the snow aside with a forepaw.
I carry it off and bury it in a snowdrift.
You dropped it; not my concern.

lines.zh: 这块骨头，我要拖回窝里。
lines.en: This bone is coming back to my den.

lines.zh: 针叶林里，我的獠牙很显眼。
lines.en: In the conifers, my fangs show.
My head goes low.
All my fangs show.
My claws dig into the frozen soil.
My companions close in too.

lines.zh: 我的头低下去，牙全露出来。
lines.en: My head lowers and every tooth shows.
This is no test.
I watch your legs.
You cannot outrun the snow.

lines.zh: 我低着头穿过针叶林，牙留在外面。
lines.en: Head low through the conifers, fangs bared.
I break the ice crust and come for you.

lines.zh: 我从冻土缝里抬起鼻子。
lines.en: I lift my nose from the frozen soil crack.
These fangs outdate the era.
The snow cannot hide your smell.
I circle behind the trees.
I draw nearer.
You have backed up the slope.
The slope is slicker.
My growl shakes the snow.
Step by step, I follow through the snow.

lines.zh: 我的爪印在你后面连成线。
lines.en: My paw prints trail behind you in a line.
Ahead is a rock face.
You have stopped.

lines.zh: 我伏在雪里，只露出背脊。
lines.en: I lie in the snow with only my spine showing.

lines.zh: 针叶林的雪，盖住了我的脚。
lines.en: Taiga snow covers my feet.
My fangs tear your armor.
In the taiga, two or three together.
My forepaws pin you.
That bite reached bone.
Red stains the snow.

lines.zh: 我的长牙咬穿你的护腿。
lines.en: My canines punch through your leg guard.
You have not got up.
My companions are watching.
You cannot pull free.
I step out of the conifers.
My companions follow behind.

lines.zh: 我们的脚印印在新雪上。
lines.en: Our prints mark the new snow.

lines.zh: 我的第一口气白得像烟。
lines.en: My first breath is white as smoke.
I lift my head and smell resin.

lines.zh: 针叶上的雪落进我的鬃毛。
lines.en: Snow from the needles falls into my mane.
I lower my head to the ground.
Pine needles crunch underfoot.

lines.zh: 我从林线那头慢慢走来。
lines.en: I come slowly from the treeline.
Three of us together.
My fangs show for the first time.
I head toward a scent.
We spread out a little.
Then we come together again.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的毛，我往后跳。
lines.en: Fire catches my fur and I spring back.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滚下去，摔进雪里。
lines.en: I roll down the slope into the snow.

lines.zh: 冰水灌进我的鼻子，我拼命挣。
lines.en: Icy water fills my nose and I thrash.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我抛起，雪都化了。
lines.en: The blast throws me up and the snow melts.
The arrow lodges in my shoulder blade; I growl.
Spell-light bursts across my fur.
There is nothing under the snow.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，整片林子都亮了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and the whole wood lights up.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有雪，也没有树。
lines.en: No snow and no trees in the void.
